name: Switzerland
sources: GDP: nominal CHF 331bn in 1990 at the year-average 1.389 CHF/USD gives about $238bn (SNB / BFS national accounts). Population 6.71m (BFS, 1990).
Inflation 5.4% (BFS consumer price index, 1990) - the highest Swiss print since 1981. SNB discount rate 6.0%, Lombard rate 8.5%.
Tax revenue 25% of GDP (OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990), the lowest in Western Europe, and general government debt near 31% of GDP.

Defence 1.8% of GDP. Strength 10 is a militia army with about 625,000 mobilisable under Armee 61 and effectively zero deployable fraction: armed neutrality is a defensive posture by constitutional design.
Stability 85: the highest on the roster. Switzerland was not a UN member in 1990 and did not join the EC.
Separatism 0.03 is the residue of the Jura question, settled by the creation of the canton in 1979 but still live in the Laufental and Moutier.
